findings.claim: On April 22, 2024, during an active SEC examination of WCA that commenced on March 11, 2024, Whitmore instructed WCA's IT Administrator Tomás Delgado to delete folders containing trade allocation spreadsheets from 2021 and early 2022.

quotes.quote: On or about April 22, 2024, during the pendency of the SEC examination of WCA (which had commenced on March 11, 2024), Whitmore instructed WCA's IT Administrator, Tomás Delgado ("Delgado"), to "clean up the shared drive" by deleting certain folders on the Firm's internal network server that contained trade allocation spreadsheets from 2021 and early 2022.

findings.claim: On April 15, 2024, Whitmore sent an email to IT Administrator Tomás Delgado instructing him to clean up legacy files on the shared drive, specifically requesting removal of old allocation folders from 2021 through early 2022.

quotes.quote: When you get a chance, I'd like you to do a clean up of legacy files on the shared drive. Specifically, the old allocation folders under Trading Ops — the trade allocation spreadsheets from 2021 and early 2022 are still sitting out there and cluttering things up. Go ahead and clear those out.

findings.claim: The SEC examination commenced on March 11, 2024, and by the time of the email on April 15, 2024 (and the instruction described on April 22, 2024), the examination staff had already issued multiple document request lists specifically requesting trade allocation records covering the entire Review Period from January 1, 2021 through December 31, 2023.
